description.value: Le Chamois is a boutique ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's upper Village, situated steps from Blackcomb Mountain's Wizard and Magic chair lifts. Rooms feature in-suite kitchenettes, mountain or courtyard views, and European-inflected décor. It positions itself as a four-season base camp — summer guests have direct access to mountain biking and hiking trails alongside on-site bike rentals through lodge shops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and detailed. The front page and /amenities subpage list amenities explicitly including 'Self-Serve Laundry,' 'Free High Speed Internet (WiFi),' a 'charging station,' and an 'on-site restaurant.' The FAQ page lists 'Do You Have Ski, Snowboard And Bike Storage?' as a question, and the /amenities page references a ski valet service for overnight gear storage, but neither source provides the actual answer text confirming bike storage details — so that criterion is null. Contact details (address, phone 604-932-8700, website) are corroborated across all subpages.
concerns: FAQ page lists 'Do You Have Ski, Snowboard And Bike Storage?' as a question but the answer body was not captured in the fetched content — secure bike storage cannot be confirmed or denied from available evidence.
Website prominently lists a toll-free number (1-888-621-1177) not present in the OSM record; OSM only has the direct line (+1-604-932-8700).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational boutique hotel in central Whistler with a fully functional website, confirmed contact details, and clear relevance to touring cyclists as a four-season accommodation with bike access nearby.
